items.title: Google froze its open source bug bounty program due to a ‘significant rise’ in AI submissions
items.summary: AI slop seems to be overwhelming bug bounty programs.

items.title: Can ‘super intelligence’ and a non-binding safety pact solve AI’s image problem?
items.summary: On Equity, we discussed the Trump administration's attempts to rebrand AI.

items.title: Trump unveils his new Super Intelligence Force
items.summary: This new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety.

items.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs
items.summary: The CEO of Amazon Web Services tried to push back against widespread suspicion of data centers.

items.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.summary: By his own admission, David Robinson is “something of a cliché”: an employee at a leading AI company who issues a dire warning while resigning from their job.

items.title: 人均带三个空箱来华购物的“China Haul”火了
items.summary: 在海外社交媒体上，又有一条关于中国的话题词“China Haul”悄然兴起。

items.title: 商务部：国庆假期前四天全国消费市场平稳有序
items.summary: 记者从商务部了解到，国庆假期过半，全国消费市场平稳有序，生活必需品货足价稳。

items.title: “心价比”崛起：情绪消费成国庆消费新主角
items.summary: 原标题：开局之年看中国·潮涌荆楚丨“心价比”崛起：情绪消费成国庆消费新主角

items.title: 湖北重点城市和景区旅游接待创新高
items.summary: 中新网武汉10月4日电 (记者 梁婷)记者4日从湖北省文旅厅获悉，该省重点旅游城市和景区迎来国庆假期第二波游客高峰，文旅市场供需两旺、热度攀升。

items.title: 从“看一眼”到“买一单” 外国游客走进中国日常
items.summary: 中新社北京10月4日电 (记者 应妮)2026年国庆黄金周，中国的城市街头和机场不时可见：外国游客拖着空行李箱落地，离境时塞满了无人机、运动相机、国潮服饰、中医艾灸盒......甚至额外再买几个新箱子装“战利品”。

items.title: 也门战事升级，沙伊博弈再添变数：地区局势会否进一步升温？
items.summary: 中新网10月5日电 日前，受美以伊冲突外溢影响，也门胡塞武装与沙特方面互袭不断，地区局势再起波澜。

items.title: 巴西总统选举首轮投票无人胜出 将进行第二轮角逐
items.summary: 新华社快讯：巴西高等选举法院4日晚公布巴西总统选举首轮投票计票结果，由于无人胜出，得票最多的前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子、自由党候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗和巴西现任总统、劳工党候选人卢拉将于10月25日进行第二轮角逐。

items.title: 泰国洪灾持续 政府启动大范围救助
items.summary: 中新社曼谷10月4日电 (李映民 王茜)泰国防灾减灾厅10月4日公布的数据显示，截至4日6时，泰国首都曼谷及27个府仍持续受到洪灾影响，约117.1万个家庭、326.3万人被波及。泰国政府正加紧开展灾害救助，并部署应对未来数日可能出现的强降雨。

items.title: 巴西总统选举开启首轮投票
items.summary: 中新社圣保罗10月4日电 (记者 林春茵)巴西利亚时间4日8时，巴西2026年总统选举开启首轮投票。首轮结果预计在当天投票结束后的数小时内揭晓。

items.title: 沙特主导联军称将继续向也门政府提供支持 应对胡塞武装袭击
items.summary: 当地时间10月4日，沙特阿拉伯主导的多国联军司令部发表声明称，联军将继续向也门政府及其武装部队提供全面作战支持，以“恢复国家”。

items.title: Brazil election goes to run-off as right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round
items.summary: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

items.title: Rescuers suspend search for survivors after plane went missing off US coast
items.summary: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

items.title: What to know about Brazil's election as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off
items.summary: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.

items.title: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
items.summary: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.

items.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
items.summary: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.
